equipmentSummary.description: (26) Caterpillar C175-16 emergency diesel-fired engine gen-sets
equipmentSummary.controls: Nitrogen oxides (NOx) controlled by engine design; Carbon monoxide (CO), particulate matter (PM10/PM2.5), volatile organic compounds (VOC), nitrogen oxide (NOx) (as NO2), and visible emissions controlled by good operating practices and manufacturer recommendations.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operation only in situations arising from sudden and unforeseeable events disrupting primary energy/power source (e.g., electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies), for participation in ISO-declared emergencies (abnormal system conditions, capacity deficiency/excess, fuel shortage, abnormal natural/man-made threats, external ISO events), for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), for unscheduled maintenance, testing, and operational training, and for the integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operate and maintain according to manufacturer's written instructions or approved procedures; settings may only be changed if permitted by manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (Scheduled MCRT, Testing, Training)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: No emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No operation for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (Integration Operational Period)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During integration operational period, operation between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. from May 1 through September 30 only if forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for Northern Virginia is <= 100. Operation shall be minimized if Air Alert is issued.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not more than 29 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT). Annual limits calculated monthly as sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Not more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits calculated monthly as sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil, meeting ASTM D975 for Grade No. 1-D S15 or Grade No. 2-D S15, OR maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of 40 or maximum aromatic content of 35 volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 694,540 gallons of diesel fuel per consecutive 365-day period (all uses). Calculated daily.

emissionLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
emissionLimits.conditions: Except during one six-minute period in any one-hour not exceeding 10% opacity. Applies at all times except during startup, shutdown and malfunction.

emissionLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. GEN-1 through GEN-26)
emissionLimits.conditions: Except during one six-minute period in any one-hour not exceeding 20% opacity. Applies during startup and shutdown.
